source_text: Floor levels of habitable rooms must be a minimum of 0.5m above the 1% AEP flood level at that location. For areas of minor overland flow (a flood depth of 300mm or less or overland flow of 2cum/sec or less) a lower freeboard of 300mm may be considered on its merits.
condition: Applies to floor levels of habitable rooms in new residential development; a lower freeboard of 300mm may be considered on its merits for areas of minor overland flow (flood depth 300mm or less, or overland flow 2 cum/sec or less).

source_text:
The habitable floor levels of development are to be a minimum 500mm above
the 100-year flood level.
condition: Interim provision: applies where a catchment is affected by riverine or stormwater flooding and Council has not yet adopted a floodplain risk management plan or flood study for that catchment.

source_text:
(v) Minimum floor levels should be the 100-year flood level plus 0.5m
freeboard.
condition: Applies only to future dwellings on the specific subdivided lots at 67 and 69 Carinya Road, Picnic Point (Schedule 4A precinct subdivision controls) -- not the council's general flood control.

source_text:
9.8 Habitable floor levels of all residential and institutional buildings are to be a minimum
of 0.5m above the 1 in 100-year flood level.
condition: Applies to habitable floor levels of residential and institutional buildings on sites affected by 1-in-100-year (mainstream) flooding (general overland flow / drainage provisions, Section 9).

source_text:
10.2 Flood levels of all habitable rooms should be 0.5m or more above the standard flood
level. A certificate by a registered practicing surveyor certifying the level of the
completed building will be required.
condition: Applies to development on land within the 1-in-100-year Flood Standard area for Salt Pan Creek and the Cooks River (former Canterbury LGA) and nearby sites (Section 10).

source_text:
3 Where the design flood standard is less than 20m3/s, or identified as
overland flow on the Flood Planning Area Map* the minimum floor
level of all enclosed areas and structures, including all habitable floor
areas, is to be either:
i) 300mm above the design flood standard level; or
ii) 300mm above the highest existing ground level along the
associated overland flow path; or
iii) whichever is the greater, except in the case of garages, where
the minimum height is to be 150mm instead of 300mm, and in-
ground swimming pools, which is to be designed in accordance
with the provisions of 24D.7 (4) of this Part
condition: Applies where the design flood standard is less than 20 cubic metres/second, or identified as overland flow on the Flood Planning Area Map; floor level is the greater of 300mm above the design flood standard level or 300mm above the highest existing ground level along the overland flow path; garages have a reduced minimum of 150mm instead of 300mm.

source_text:
4 Where the design flood standard exceeds 20m3/s, or as identified
as mainstream flow on the Flood Planning Area Map* the minimum
floor level for all enclosed areas, including all habitable floor areas,
are to be 500mm above the design flood standard level, except in
the case of garages, where the minimum height is to be 300mm, and
in- ground swimming pools, which is to be designed in accordance
with the provisions of 24D.7 (3,4,5) of this Part.
condition: Applies where the design flood standard exceeds 20 cubic metres/second, or is identified as mainstream flow on the Flood Planning Area Map; garages have a reduced minimum of 300mm instead of 500mm.

source_text:
5. Development consisting of the following sensitive land uses in PMF affected areas
must provide 0.5 metres freeboard above the PMF flood event level:
i. Early education and child facilities.
ii. Educational establishments.
iii. Health services facilities
iv. Group homes
v. Seniors housing
vi. Respite day care centres
condition: Applies only to specific sensitive land uses in Probable Maximum Flood (PMF) affected areas (early education/child care, educational establishments, health services facilities, group homes, seniors housing, respite day care centres); of these, only seniors housing matches this schema's dev_type list.

source_text:
62. New buildings or extensions involving habitable areas are to be designed to prevent the entry of stormwater for floods up to 100 year ARI and all
new habitable floor levels are to have a 500mm freeboard to the 100 year ARI flood.
condition: Applies to new buildings or extensions with habitable areas at the Warringah Mall precinct (G4); floor levels must also be designed to prevent stormwater entry for floods up to the 100-year ARI.

source_text:
63. Structural measures are to be implemented on the site as part of any significant alterations to existing buildings that will ensure affected
habitable floor levels have a 300mm freeboard to the 100 year ARI flood.
condition: Applies to significant alterations to existing buildings with habitable floor levels at the Warringah Mall precinct (G4); a reduced standard versus new development (500mm freeboard, cl.62).

source_text:
a) In the 1% AEP event with 100% blockage, Council will require minimum finished floor levels
of habitable rooms to be 500mm freeboard above the adjacent 1% AEP water surface level
as mapped in the 2 Dimension (Tuflow) overland flow model accepted by Council. This level
may vary along the site/building boundary with changing water levels.
condition: Applies to buildings that are part of or adjacent to an overland flow path or flood storage area in the Melrose Park Urban Renewal Precinct (Local Centres); measured against the 1% AEP water surface level (100% blockage) mapped in Council's accepted 2D (Tuflow) overland flow model.

source_text:
C.12 The Flood Planning Levels shall be the adjacent interpolated 1% AEP flood levels (100%
blocked) plus 0.5 metre freeboard.
C.13 Minimum finished floor levels must be the respective Flood Planning Levels as defined above.
condition: Applies to the Melrose Park South Planning Precinct water management strategy; minimum finished floor levels must equal the Flood Planning Level (interpolated 1% AEP flood level, 100% blockage, plus 0.5m freeboard).

source_text:
C.01 To achieve a safe environment for occupants within a building, residential habitable rooms
must be set at or above the Flood Planning Level (FPL), which is the adjacent 1% AEP flood
level plus a 500mm freeboard safety factor.
condition: Applies to residential habitable rooms within the Parramatta City Centre Flood Risk Management area (Section 9.7).

source_text:
C.03 All habitable rooms/floors must be above the 1% annual exceedance probability (AEP) flood
level plus 0.5m freeboard.
condition: Applies specifically to the named site at 142-154 Macquarie Street, 118 Harris Street and 135 George Street (Section 9.10.10.5 Flood Risk Management).
